name: result-box
title: ResultBox
description: Framed result or feedback line in a role="status" box: a tone icon, an optional title, the text, an optional action and an optional dismiss button. Used for the Admin toast and export result, the Sources undo banner, the Workflows warning block, the Traces replay feedback and the Workflow validation band.

a11y.pattern: <div role="status"> (polite live region) holding an aria-hidden tone icon, the text, and real <button>/<a> actions
keyboard: Reaches the action and the dismiss button
aria: role="status" announces the new text politely, without moving focus
The tone icon is decorative; the words say what happened ("Imported", "cannot run")
The dismiss button is named "Dismiss message" (dismissLabel)
live="off" removes the role for a box that is static page content, not feedback
bordered={false} and surface="raised" only change the look (no frame, raised fill): the role, the decorative icon and the words stay the same; the raised fill keeps text at 4.5:1 in both themes
a11y.notes: A live region only announces changes: keep the box mounted (or its container role="status") before the result arrives, or announce the result elsewhere. If it hides itself (toast after 4 s), move focus nowhere and keep the result reachable on the page.
